summary: preinstall hook exfiltrates host and user identifiers to hardcoded Discord webhook
details: The package's npm preinstall lifecycle script (preinstall.js) runs automatically on `npm install` and transmits installer-side identifiers to an attacker-controlled endpoint. On line 23 it reads `os.hostname()` and `os.userInfo().username`, composes a message including those values, and on line 33 POSTs the payload to a hardcoded Discord webhook at https://canary.discord.com/api/webhooks/1566232728179843243/.... The destination is a Discord webhook (not the package publisher's infrastructure), the behavior is undocumented, and no opt-out is provided. Installing this package causes host and user identity information to be sent to a third-party endpoint controlled by whoever created the webhook.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
